title: Echo
blurb: Your headlamp has died deep in a cave, and it's pitch black. Snap, clap or whistle and each sound sends out a ripple of sight that lights only what it reaches: the snap is short and sharp, the whistle carries farthest but blurs. Walls send the ripple back to you, and water scatters it. Hear your way through tunnels, a maze, flooded sumps and rockfalls toward the light.
